label: Bible Study
prompt: Those things, which ye have both _____, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verse: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
note: Paul's teaching method — watch me, then do it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jesus said unto him, This day is _____ come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verse: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
note: Zacchaeus came down from the sycamore tree, and by dinner salvation had come to his whole house.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was _____.
verse: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
note: 'Alas, master! for it was borrowed' — the axe head sank, and the worker's real worry was paying it back.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then we which are alive and remain shall be _____ up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verse: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
note: The meeting in the air — and Paul saves the best line for last: 'so shall we ever be with the Lord.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven _____ violence, and the violent take it by force.
verse: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
note: One of Jesus' most debated sayings: the kingdom 'suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.'
